Example 2 (2025-06-03) shows the same pattern.

Example 4 (2024-09-02):
- History: Price range ~60.29 to 73.14
- Sentiment: Varied from 0.00 to 1.00
- Model forecasts: Start at 71.04, gradually decreasing to ~67.09 by day 25
- True outcomes: Start at 70.43, gradually decreasing to ~60.29 by day 25

Let me look at the deviations in Example 4:
- Day 1: Model 71.04 vs True 70.43 (+0.61)
- Day 5: Model 69.53 vs True 66.50 (+3.03)
- Day 10: Model 69.15 vs True 64.99 (+4.16)
- Day 15: Model 69.94 vs True 63.39 (+6.55)
- Day 20: Model 72.55 vs True 65.56 (+6.99)
- Day 25: Model 68.87 vs True 60.29 (+8.58)

So in Example 4, the model consistently overforecasts by a growing amount as we look further into the horizon.
